blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to human preferences, after pre-training and supervised fine-tuning steps. However, standard RL alignment steps such as RLHF do not focus on factuality of LLMs, hence they may generate non-factual information, which could result in unintended consequences. In response, a number of factuality alignment approaches have been proposed in the literature which claim to improve factuality of LLMs on their own benchmarks. However, these methods have not been reproduced independently and are also not comparable since each uses a different base model, training data, evaluation set, judge, and metric. In this paper, we present the first independent reproduction of five factuality alignment methods, which span on-policy RL (PPO, GRPO, and Dr.~GRPO) and offline preference optimization (DPO and KTO), and compare them on a common benchmark with common evaluation metrics. We found that none of these methods reproduces in full, and on the common benchmark none of the methods significantly outperforms the base model. On closer inspection, the rewards optimize for format, length, or brevity rather than factuality and relevance, whereas the choice between on-policy and offline training matters little. Furthermore, the evaluation metrics and benchmarks are also part of the problem since they do not measure relevance of text to the prompt. Since there is no ground truth associated with the prompts, the reliance on LLM judges and retrieval for verification also makes the evaluation fragile. We release our code, data, and checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在经过了预训和受监督的微调步骤后,与人类偏好相适应. 然而,RLHF等标准RL校正步骤并不注重LLMs的事实性,因此它们可能产生非事实性信息,这可能导致出乎意料的后果. 作为回应,文献中提出了若干事实一致性方法,声称根据自己的基准提高有限责任公司的事实质量。 然而,这些方法并非是独立复制的,也不具有可比性,因为每种方法都使用不同的基准模型、培训数据、评价集、法官和衡量标准。 在本文件中,我们首次独立复制了五种实际质量调整方法,这些方法跨越政策上的RL(PPO、GRPO和Dr.~GRPO)和离线偏好优化(DPO和KTO),并以共同基准与共同评价指标进行比较。 我们发现,没有一种方法能完全复制,在共同基准上,没有一种方法能大大超过基准模型。 在进行更仔细的检查时,对格式、长度或简短的奖励是最佳的,而不是对事实和相关性的奖励,而政策培训与线下培训之间的选择则无关紧要。 此外,评价指标和基准也是问题的一部分,因为它们没有衡量案文与及时性的相关性。 由于这些提示没有基本事实,依赖LLM法官和检索进行核查也使评价变得脆弱。 我们公布我们的代码,数据和检查站。

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to follow instructions as part of their standard training process. But alignment methods such as Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) ( Christiano et al., 2017 ) are shown to degrade factuality of LLMs ( Lin et al., 2024 ) . In response, a number of factuality alignment methods have emerged: factuality-aware SFT and DPO ( Lin et al., 2024 ) , fine-grained KTO over sentence-level labels ( Huang and Chen, 2024 ) , reinforcement learning against a knowledge-boundary reward ( Ren et al., 2026 ) , a programmatic reward over long chains of thought ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and PPO conditioned on an estimated knowledge state ( Dong et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)被调整为遵循指令作为其标准培训过程的一部分. 但诸如从人类反馈中强化学习(RLHF)(Christiano等,2017年)等校正方法被证明会降低LLMs的事实性(Lin等,2024年). 对此,出现了多条事实校正方法:事实感知SFT和DPO(Lin等,2024年),优异地给KTO打过句子级标签(Huang和Chen等,2024年),强化学习以知识分界奖励(Ren等,2026年),方案奖励长链思想(Chen等,2026年),PPO以估计知识状态为条件(Dong等,2026年).

blocks.en: However, none of these gains have been independently reproduced, and it is also not feasible to compare them with each other since these five methods use different base models, training data, evaluation sets, judges, and metrics. The improvements reported by these papers are therefore neither replicable nor generalizable.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些成果没有一项是独立复制的,相互比较也是不可行的,因为这五种方法使用不同的基准模型、培训数据、评价集、法官和衡量标准。 因此,这些文件所报告的改进既不能重复,也不能概括。

blocks.en: This paper is the first reproducibility effort on all five methods. Reproducing these methods is not straightforward. For example, the authors of Flame do not release the code, and even when the code is released, the configuration and setup used in the code deviate from what is documented in the paper (Table 5 summarizes what the authors released). We try our best to reproduce as faithfully as possible to the setup described in the papers and document every deviation (Figure 2 and Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 本文件是关于所有五种方法的第一次可复制努力。 复制这些方法并不简单。 例如Flame的作者不发布代码,即使在代码发布时,代码中使用的配置和设置也偏离了论文所记载的内容(表5总结了作者发布的内容). 我们尽力尽可能忠实地复制文件所描述的设置,并记录每个偏差(图2和附录A)。

blocks.en: To make the comparison feasible and fair, we also train every method on a single base model, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , with the training regime and data that its paper specifies, and evaluate on a common benchmark with two long-form generation tasks scored with VeriScore ( Song et al., 2024 ) and two short-form question answering tasks graded by an LLM judge.
blocks.zh: 为了使比较可行而公平,我们还用一个单一的基础模型Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(Grattafiori等,2024年)培训每一种方法,并采用其文件规定的培训制度和数据,并用一个共同基准评估两个由VeriScore(Song等,2024年)评分的长式生成任务和由LLM法官评分的两个短式问答任务。

blocks.en: Our study is driven by the following research questions: • RQ I : Do the published gains hold when we reproduce each method, first in its own setup and then on a common benchmark? • RQ II : How does the reward design affect long-form and short-form factuality? • RQ III : Does the training paradigm, on-policy reinforcement learning or offline preference optimization, affect factuality? • RQ IV : Do the current evaluation metrics measure factuality faithfully?

blocks.en:
Our study yields four findings. First, none of the methods reproduce the published results completely when we rebuild the training pipeline independently.
For instance, the factuality gain of Flame reproduces, but its claim that factuality alignment costs no helpfulness does not, and FactAlign reproduces with its released checkpoint but not when retrained.
On the common benchmark, none of the methods significantly outperforms the untrained base model.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究得出了四个结论。 首先,在我们独立重建培训管道时,没有一种方法完全照搬已公布的结果。
例如, " 火焰 " 的事实收益是再现的,但是它声称 " 事实一致性 " 并不产生任何帮助,而 " 事实 " 则随其开放的检查站而再现,但在重新训练时则不会。
在共同基准上,没有一种方法明显地超过未经训练的基础模型。

blocks.en:
Second, the rewards optimize for length, format, or brevity rather than factuality and relevance, and the models exploit this, which is commonly referred to as reward hacking .
For instance, the FactGRPO reward counts a claim as correct whenever evidence supports it, even if it is irrelevant to the prompt, and 36% of its biography responses contain such claims.
The KnowRL and Faith rewards are built for short questions with a gold answer and break down on long-form prompts, where the answers of KnowRL grow long and imprecise and those of Faith shrink to one word.
blocks.zh:
第二,奖励在长度、格式或简洁性方面最优化,而不是在事实和相关性方面,这些模型利用了这一点,通常称之为奖励黑客。
例如,FactGRPO的奖励认为,只要有证据支持,索赔就是正确的,即使它与迅速无关,而且36%的传记答复都载有这种索赔。
KnowRL和Faith的奖励是为短题而建,用黄金答案来解答并用长式提示来解答,其中KnowRL的答案会长而不准确,而Faith的答案会缩到一字.

blocks.en: Third, the training paradigm matters less than the reward. On-policy RL and offline preference optimization perform similarly on the common benchmark, and the alignment step barely changes the model from the supervised fine-tuning stage.
blocks.zh: 第三,培训模式的重要性小于奖励。 政策RL和离线优惠优化在共同基准上表现类似,对接步骤从受监督的微调阶段勉强改变模型.

blocks.en:
Finally, the evaluation itself is part of the problem. The factuality metrics used in benchmarks such as FActScore ( Min et al., 2023 ) , SAFE ( Wei et al., 2024b ) , and VeriScore ( Song et al., 2024 ) credit claims supported by evidence irrespective of the claim’s relevance to the prompt. Filtering out irrelevant claims reduces precision by 4–15 percentage points across all methods that answer at length.
Without ground truth, the scores also depend on the evidence source, the recall normalizer, and the LLM judge, each of which moves the results more than any method.
blocks.zh:
最后,评价本身也是问题的一部分。 FActScore(Min等,2023年),SAFE(Wei等,2024年b)和VeriScore(Song等,2024年)信贷索赔等基准中使用的事实质量衡量标准,无论索赔与迅速索赔是否相关,都有证据证明。 过滤无关紧要的索赔要求,将长度回答的所有方法的精度降低4至15个百分点.
没有地心真理,分数也取决于证据来源,召回正常化者,以及LLM裁判,每个裁判都比任何方法更能移动结果.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Factuality Alignment
blocks.zh: 2.1 事实调整

blocks.en:
Factuality in LLMs refers to the capability of the LLMs to generate content that adheres to factual information grounded in common sense, domain-related facts, and world knowledge ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
While instruction-tuned LLMs have led to tremendous advances in a wide range of natural language tasks, they still suffer from issues such as hallucination, which might result in non-factual outputs. To improve factuality, among training-free strategies are self-consistency-based uncertainty estimation during decoding ( Tian et al., 2023 ) and other decoding approaches ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) . Alternatively, post-training methods such as SFT ( Tao et al., 2024 ) and policy optimization ( Dong et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ; Huang and Chen, 2024 ) have been proposed for factuality alignment of such models. Policy optimization approaches can be on-policy or off-policy. Approaches like FactTune ( Tian et al., 2024 ) construct preference pairs using generated responses and FActScore ( Min et al., 2023 ) as a feedback signal. They then employ Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) in an off-policy fashion over this collected preference pairs dataset. Flame ( Lin et al., 2024 ) also proposes a similar approach but collects self-generated traces for factuality-aware alignment, combining factuality-aware SFT and a factuality-aware RL loop through DPO. KnowTuning ( Lyu et al., 2024 ) proposed fine-grained knowledge augmentation to identify difficult knowledge. They also employ DPO to help LLMs differentiate between reliable and unreliable knowledge. Alternatively, on-policy methods have demonstrated that training on self-generated traces during optimization is better than training on reference traces or static self-generated traces, which may cause more hallucination due to distribution mismatch ( Kang et al., 2025 ; Gekhman et al., 2024 ; Ghosal et al., 2024 ) . With the success of DeepSeek employing on-policy RL using GRPO, similar RL-based tuning approaches have been proposed for factuality alignment in LLMs ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . While these approaches mostly focus on short-form generation, approach like ( Chen et al., 2026 ) propose factuality-aware and aligned reasoning for long-form responses.
blocks.zh:
LLMs中的事实性是指LLMs生成坚持基于常识的事实信息,与域相关的事实,以及世界知识等内容的能力(Wang等,2026.
虽然教学调校LLMS在广泛的自然语言任务上取得了巨大进步,但它们仍然受到幻觉等问题的影响,这可能导致非事实产出. 为了提高实际性,在无培训战略中,有的是在解码期间基于自我一致性的不确定性估计(Tian等人,2023年)和其他解码方法(Kadavath等人,2022年)。 或者,SFT(Tao等,2024年)和政策优化(Dong等,2026年;Chen等,2026年;Ren等,2026年;Huang等,2024年;Chen等)等培训后方法被提议用于此类模式的实际一致性。 政策优化办法可以是政策上的,也可以是政策外。 FactTune(Tian等,2024年)等方法利用生成的响应和FActScore(Min等,2023年)作为反馈信号构建了偏好对. 然后,它们以非政策方式使用直接偏好优化(DPO)来取代所收集的偏好对数据集。 Flame(Lin等,2024年)也提出了类似的方法,但收集了自我生成的痕迹来进行现实感-知对接,通过DPO将事实感-知-知-知-会SFT和现实感-知-知-会RL环相融合. 认识Tuning (Lyu等,2024年)提出精细增殖知识以识别困难知识. 他们还利用DPO帮助LLMs区分可靠和不可靠的知识. 或者,政策方法已经表明,在优化期间,自我生成痕迹的培训优于参考痕迹或静态自我生成痕迹的培训,这些痕迹可能由于分配不匹配而产生更多的幻觉(Kang等,2025;Gekhman等,2024;Ghosal等,2024)。 随着DeepSeek成功采用使用GRPO的政策性RL,也提出了类似的基于RL的调整方法,以在LLMs(Zhang等,2024年)中实现实际一致性. 虽然这些方法主要侧重于短形式生成,但类似(Chen等人,2026年)的方法提出了对事实的认识,并对长形式反应进行了一致的推理。

blocks.en: 2.2 Factuality Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.2 事实评估

blocks.en:
Several evaluation setups and metrics have been proposed for factuality in short-form and long-form responses from LLMs. Evaluating the factuality of long-form responses is hard, and hence prior approaches have proposed breaking them down into atomic claims to be verified ( Kamoi et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Guan et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024b ) .
FActScore ( Min et al., 2023 ) extracts atomic facts, which are statements that each contain a single piece of information. However, its extraction
method is specific to the domain of biographies and is inapplicable to other domains. SAFE ( Wei et al., 2024b ) extends to domains beyond biography and adopts a three-stage pipeline comprising a claim extraction stage, claim revision stage to resolve vague references, and a claim relevance check stage. While this leads to better evaluation compared to FActScore, Song et al. (2024) argue that the relevance check stage also significantly removes verifiable claims, undermining evaluation of the factuality of generated text. VeriScore ( Song et al., 2024 ) was proposed to overcome these limitations and avoid the fallacy of treating all atomic claims as verifiable. VeriScore extracts only verifiable claims and is also one of the first methods to consider inter-sentence context when extracting claims. This also helps avoid the cost incurred by claim revision.
blocks.zh:
已经提出了若干评价设置和衡量标准,以便从有限责任管理小组得到短式和长式答复。 评估长式答复的事实性是困难的,因此,以往的做法建议将它们细分为有待核实的原子主张(Kamoi等,2023;Gao等,2023;Guan等,2024;Wei等,2024b)。
FActScore (Min等,2023年) 取出原子事实,这些事实是声明,分别包含一个单一的信息. 然而,它的提取
方法是特定于传记领域,不适用于其他领域。 SAFE(Wei等,2024年b)延伸至传记以外的领域,并采用分三阶段的管道,包括索赔提取阶段、索赔修订阶段以解决含糊的提法,以及索赔相关性检查阶段。 虽然这与FActScore相比导致更好的评价,但Song等(2024年)认为,关联性检查阶段也显著地去除了可核查的主张,破坏了对生成文本真实性的评价. VeriScore(Song等人,2024年)被提议克服这些限制并避免将所有原子主张视为可核查的谬论. VeriScore只摘录可核查的索赔,也是在提取索赔时首先考虑判决间背景的方法之一. 这也有助于避免索赔修订引起的费用。

blocks.en: Existing factuality alignment approaches are not evaluated in a common setup with common benchmarks and a reliable metric. Our study primarily contributes to the rigorous evaluation of factuality alignment methods for LLMs in such a standardized setup and to an analysis of the reliability of its factuality metrics.
blocks.zh: 现有事实一致性方法没有在具有共同基准和可靠衡量标准的共同结构中加以评价。 我们的研究主要有助于严格评价这种标准化设置中有限责任公司的事实质量调整方法,并分析其实际质量衡量标准的可靠性。

blocks.en: KnowRL ( Ren et al., 2026 ) adopts GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) on top of a cold-start SFT stage, with factual supervision introduced into the chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning process. The reward is of the form r = r format + r correct + r fact r=r_{\text{format}}+r_{\text{correct}}+r_{\text{fact}} . The correctness term gives + 2 +2 for a correct answer, − 1 -1 for an incorrect answer, and + 1 +1 for an explicit non-attempt. Abstaining therefore receives a higher reward than answering incorrectly. The authors argue that the cold-start stage is needed to keep training stable under this reward.
blocks.zh: KnowRL(Ren等,2026年)采用GRPO(Shao等,2024年)在冷起伏的SFT阶段上,将事实监督引入了思维链(COT)推理过程. 奖励形式为r=r格式+r正文+r正文 r=r正文 r=text{format}}+r_{\text{正文}}+r_{\text{fact}}}. 正确性术语给出了+2+2的正确答案,−1-1的正确答案,而+1+1的正确答案是明确的不尝试. 因此,弃权者的报酬高于不正确的答复。 提交人认为,需要在这种奖励下保持培训的稳定,需要冷启动阶段。

blocks.en: Faith ( Dong et al., 2026 ) conditions generation on an estimated knowledge state . For each training question, the method samples multiple responses and computes their consistency and semantic entropy. These statistics determine one of four states, defined by whether the model is estimated to possess the knowledge ( K K or ¬ K \neg K ) and whether its answer reflects that knowledge ( H H or ¬ H \neg H ). The paper calls these dimensions “trustworthiness” and “honestness.” The estimated state is written into the prompt, and PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) uses an additional state-dependent reward of + 2 +2 , + 1 +1 , − 1 -1 , or − 2 -2 .
blocks.zh: Faith(Dong等,2026年)在估计的知识状态上创造了条件。 对于每个训练问题,方法对多个响应进行抽样并计算其一致性和语义通义. 这些统计数据决定了四个州中的一个,其定义是该模型是否估计拥有该知识(K K 或 ¬ K \neg K ),以及其答案是否反映了该知识(H 或 ¬ H\neg H ). 本文称这些方面为“可信赖性”和“诚实性”。 估计状态被写入"快报"中,而PPO(Schulman等,2017年)则使用附加的以州为主的奖励+2+2,+1+1,−1–1,或−2-2.

blocks.en: The methods differ in both the unit of supervision and their treatment of abstention. Flame , FactAlign , and FactGRPO score claims extracted from long-form responses. KnowRL and Faith score short answers and give credit for abstention. KnowRL assigns + 1 +1 to a non-attempt and − 1 -1 to an incorrect answer, while Faith rewards appropriate refusals. In FactGRPO , S / ( 1 + T ) S/(1+T) rewards more claims at fixed positive precision.
blocks.zh: 监督单位和弃权处理方法各不相同。 Flame, FactAlign, and FactGRPO 从长式回放中提取的分数索赔. KnowRL和Faith给出了简短的答案,并对弃权给予肯定. KnowRL将+1+1指定为非尝试,而−1-1指定为错误的答案,而Faith则奖励适当的拒绝. 在FactGRPO中,S / (1 + T) S/ (1+T)以固定正精度奖励更多的索赔.

blocks.zh: 4 在原设定中复制

blocks.en: To answer RQ I , we first reproduce each method in its original setup, with the released code, data, and checkpoints (where available), and record for every component whether it is faithful, substituted, or partial (last column of Figure 2 ; Appendix A lists every deviation). Tables 27 and 26 in the appendix list the training stages, data, and metrics of each paper. We contacted the authors of all five papers about the discrepancies between the released artifacts and the papers, and only the Faith authors had replied at the time of writing (Appendix A.5 ). Table 1 sets the published numbers against ours. We observe that all methods except Faith and FactGRPO follow a similar trend as their respective original implementations, although none reproduces their published results in full.
blocks.zh: 为了回答RQ I,我们首先在最初的设置中复制了每种方法,并附有已公布的代码、数据和检查站(如果有的话),并记录每个组成部分是否忠实、替代或部分(图2最后一栏;附录A列出每个偏差)。 附录中的表27和表26列出了每份文件的培训阶段、数据和衡量标准。 我们联系了所有五篇论文的作者,这些论文涉及已发行的文物与论文之间的差异,在撰写本报告时只有信仰作者作了答复(附录A.5 )。 表1列出公布的数字。 我们观察到,除Faith和FactGRPO之外,所有方法都遵循着与各自原始执行类似的趋势,尽管没有任何方法完全照搬其公布的结果。

blocks.en: Flame . We retrain all four models at 70B with open reward models and gpt-4-turbo in place of the unreleased reward models and the retired judge. The factuality claim reproduces, with a biography FActScore above the published one, whereas the claim that factuality alignment costs no helpfulness does not, since our AlpacaEval win rate falls well below the published one (Appendix A.1 ).

blocks.en: FactAlign . The released checkpoint improves over its base under two retrievers, as published. Our retrain on gemma-2b for three iterations without the general-domain mixture lands at the level of the paper’s own ablation without it, so the gain depends on that mixture rather than on the objective alone (Appendix A.2 ).
blocks.zh: 事实对齐。 公布的检查站在两个取回器下改善了基地。 我们重新在Gemma-2b上进行三次迭代,没有普通-域混合物,在纸张本身的衰竭水平上进行,因此收益取决于该混合物,而不是仅仅取决于目标(附录A.2)。

blocks.en: KnowRL . Both our run with the cold-start stage followed by 150 GRPO steps and our evaluation of the released checkpoint reproduce the reported behavior without refusal collapse, albeit with lower converged rewards. In contrast, all runs using the released learning rate or omitting the cold-start stage collapse into refusals. However, closer inspection reveals that the released checkpoint abstains on most SimpleQA questions, and its score increases mechanically as refusals are excluded from the metric (Appendix A.3 ).

blocks.en: 5 Common Benchmark
blocks.zh: 5 共同基准

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en: All five methods of Section 3 are trained on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, each alignment stage as a LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) adapter of rank 32 on top of the method’s own supervised stage with the hyperparameters of its paper. Since the five methods carry too many settings to print, the full configuration of every run is listed in the code repository and summarized in Appendix D . All methods generate with greedy decoding from the bare question or instruction, with at most 1,024 new tokens for long-form prompts and 256 for short-form questions, and Faith additionally receives its estimator-predicted knowledge state in the prompt, as its paper prescribes. Benchmarks Short-form evaluation uses the first 1,000 SimpleQA questions ( Wei et al., 2024a ) and all 817 TruthfulQA questions ( Lin et al., 2022 ) , graded as correct, incorrect, or not attempted by gpt-4o using the official SimpleQA prompt. We report accuracy, abstention rate, accuracy on attempted questions, and their harmonic mean F F . Long-form evaluation uses 495 FActScore biography prompts ( Min et al., 2023 ) and 253 Alpaca-Fact instructions, selected from AlpacaEval by the Flame fact-seeking classifier following Lin et al. (2024) . We score responses with VeriScore ( Song et al., 2024 ) , which extracts verifiable claims and checks each against ten web search results. We report the average numbers of supported and unsupported claims per response, precision (assigning zero to responses with no claims), and F1 ​ @ ​ K \text{F1}@K , with K K fixed at 20 and 19, the median claim counts of an earlier pool (Section 6 ). For each long-form table, we evaluate all models on the same subset of prompts; excluded prompts are listed in Appendix D . We test significance against the base model using McNemar’s exact test for short-form evaluation and paired bootstrap resampling for long-form precision, recall, and F1 ​ @ ​ K \text{F1}@K , with 10,000 samples. We apply Holm’s correction for multiple comparisons.
blocks.zh: 第3节的所有5个方法都经过了Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的培训,每个对接阶段都作为LORA(Hu等,2022年)32级适配器在方法本身的受监督的舞台上用其纸张的超参数进行. 由于这五种方法携带了太多的设置来打印,每个运行的全部配置都列在了代码寄存器中,并在附录D中汇总. 所有方法都是用从光问题或指令中贪婪地解码生成的,最多有1,024个新符号用于长式提示,256个用于短式问题,而Faith还像其论文规定的那样,在即时得到了其预测性的知识状态. 基准短式评价采用前1000个简单QA问题(Wei等,2024a)和所有817个真能QA问题(Lin等,2022),分级为正确,不正确,或没有被gpt-4o使用官方的简单QA快取来尝试. 我们报告准确性,弃权率,尝试问题的准确性,以及它们的口音表示F. 长式评价使用495个FActScore传记提示(Min等,2023年)和253个Alpaca-Fact指令,由Flame fact-reach分类器从AlpacaEval中按照Lin等选择(2024年). 我们用VeriScore(Song等,2024年)获得答复,其中提取了可核实的主张,并对照10个网络搜索结果检查每个要求。 我们报告每个答复、精确度(将零分配给无索赔的答复)和F1@K\text{F1}@K,其中KK定为20和19, 中间索赔数为先前的集合(第6节)。 对于每个长式表格,我们评价同一分集的提示上的所有模型;排除的提示列于附录D. 我们用McNemar精确的短式评价测试基底模型, 我们用Holm的校正进行多重比较。

blocks.en: The common evaluation setup employs one base model, one decoding configuration, one judge, and one claim verifier, across all methods so that differences are attributable to training rather than to evaluation. We found that no method improves significantly over the untrained model on any of the four datasets, apart from two long-form cases discussed below. From Table 2 , we observe that Faith and FactGRPO lose about 25 and 18 points of TruthfulQA accuracy, while the other three methods stay within two points of the base model, which is not statistically significant.
blocks.zh: 共同评价设置采用一种基本模式,一种编解码配置,一种法官,一种索赔核实人,涵盖所有方法,因此差异归因于培训,而不是评价。 我们发现,除下文讨论的两个长式案例外,没有方法比四个数据集中任何一个数据集未经训练的模型大有改进。 从表2可以看出,Faith和FactGRPO损失了约25分和18分的 TruthfulQA精确度,而其他三种方法则停留在基础模型的两个点之内,这在统计学上并不重要.

blocks.en: On long-form evaluation, Faith has the highest precision on the biography task, but the gain is an artifact of 0.4 supported claims in a one-sentence (very brief) response, which is why its relevance-filtered precision is significantly above the base model, but it has the lowest F1 ​ @ ​ K \text{F1}@K (Table 3 ). Since Faith is proposed as a general factuality alignment method for LLMs and not as specific to short-form tasks, the long-form benchmarks are within its stated scope. FactGRPO has the highest F1 ​ @ ​ K \text{F1}@K on both datasets with fewer claims than the base model. Its relevance-filtered F1 ​ @ ​ K \text{F1}@K on biographies is .017 above the base model and is the only gain apart from the Faith artifact that is statistically significant, which is a small fraction of the published improvement. On SimpleQA, Flame raises its accuracy over attempted questions by declining more often while its overall accuracy stays unchanged, so the accuracy alone understates how differently these models behave. Hence, none of the methods provides substantial factuality gains in our common evaluation setting.
blocks.zh: 在长式评价上,费斯在传记任务上拥有最精确的精度,但收益是在一判决(非常简短)回复中得到0.4支持的主张的文物,这就是为何其相关性过滤精度明显高于基准模型,但拥有最低的F1@K\text{F1}@K(表3). 由于Faith被提议作为LLMS的一种一般的事实校正方法,而不是短式任务的特有方法,因此长式基准属于其规定的范围. FactGRPO在两个数据集中拥有最高的F1@K\text{F1}@K,索赔数量比基准模型要少. 它的关联性过滤了F1@K\text{F1}@K 关于活字图的活字图在基模上方为. 017,是除"信仰"文物之外唯一具有统计意义的收益,是出版后改进的一小部分. 在SimpleQA上,"火焰"(Flame)通过更频繁地下降而提高了它的精确度,而其整体精度却保持不变,因此光是准确度就低估了这些模型的表现如何不同. 因此,这些方法都没有在我们共同评价的设定中带来实质性的事实收益。

blocks.en: 5.3 Reward Design
blocks.zh: 5.3 奖励设计

blocks.en: To answer RQ II , we analyze the effect of rewards on responses. The FactGRPO reward is a function of the number of supported and total claims, with a relevance term that contributes little, so a claim that is true but does not address the prompt earns the same reward as one that does. We call such claims filler claims. They occur in about two fifths of the long-form responses of every method that answers at length (Figure 4 in the appendix), and the FactGRPO reward rises with their number (Figure 3 ), since the factuality term ℛ f ​ a ​ c ​ t \mathcal{R}_{fact} dominates the relevance term ℛ r ​ e ​ l \mathcal{R}_{rel} (Table 21 in the appendix). The model can therefore hack the reward by generating claims that are factual but off-topic. The KnowRL reward adds a format term, a verdict term, and a factuality term, but on free-form prompts only the verdict term carries a signal, since the model never emits the expected tags and the factuality term retrieves Wikipedia pages by title, which questions do not have. The Faith reward credits brevity, as described above.
blocks.zh: 为了回答RQ II,我们分析奖励对回应的影响. FactGRPO的奖励是按支持的和总的诉求数量来决定的,相关的术语贡献不大,因此这个诉求是真实的,但并不涉及迅速者得到的奖励与实际得到的相同. 我们称这种索赔为填充索赔。 它们出现在长度回答的每一种方法的长式回复中约五分之二(附录中图4),而FactGRPO的奖励随其数量而上升(图3),因为实际用词R f a c t\ mathcal{R}_{-fact}主导了相关性用词R r e l\ mathcal{R}_{r}(附录中表21). 因此,该模型可以通过提出事实性但非专题性的索赔来黑入奖励。 KnowRL奖赏增加了一个格式名词,一个判决名词,以及一个事实名词,但是在自由名词上只提示判决名词带有信号,因为该名词从不发布预期标记,而事实名词则按标题检索维基百科的页面,这些问题没有这些. 如上所述, " 信仰 " 奖赏荣誉。

blocks.en: When we score every method’s generations with every method’s reward, normalized by response length, the rewards disagree with each other and with the benchmarks (Table 19 in the appendix). Only the FactAlign and FactGRPO rewards prefer their own generations, the latter only because every other method fails its format check, whereas the Flame reward ranks the base model’s generations above Flame ’s own. Where the KnowRL and Faith rewards prefer a method over the base model, it is another method’s generations, as both rate Flame ’s generations above the base model’s, which none of the benchmarks does. The rewards therefore credit length, format, or brevity rather than the factuality that the benchmarks measure.
blocks.zh: 当我们用每一方法的奖励来奖励每一代人时,按答复时间长短来评定,奖励就彼此不一,也与基准不一(附录表19)。 只有FactAlign和FactGRPO的奖励更喜欢他们自己的几代人,而后者只是因为其他方法都未能检查格式,而Flame的奖励则将基本模型的几代人排在Flame自己的之上。 KnowRL 和 Faith 奖赏更喜欢一种方法而不是基准模型,这是另一种方法的代相传,因为两者都把Flame 的代相提并论,而这些基相没有基准。 因此,奖励的信用长度、格式或简明扼要,而不是基准衡量的事实质量。

blocks.en: 5.4 Training Paradigm
blocks.zh: 5.4 培训范式

blocks.en: To answer RQ III , we group the methods by paradigm. KnowRL , FactGRPO , and Faith optimize on-policy with GRPO, Dr. GRPO, and PPO, whereas Flame and FactAlign optimize offline with DPO and KTO on preference data. Neither group separates from the base model on the common benchmark, and the two large losses on TruthfulQA both come from on-policy methods whose training changed the output format. To separate the paradigm from the supervised data it starts from, Table 15 shows each supervised stage on its own and Table 2 the pipeline that follows it. On the short-form benchmarks the alignment step adds almost nothing, since no method moves by more than .007 in accuracy and none of the differences is significant, although individual answers do change, as FactGRPO turns 38 TruthfulQA items from incorrect to correct and 42 the other way. On the long-form benchmarks (Table 16 against Table 3 ) the alignment step moves precision and F1 ​ @ ​ K \text{F1}@K by less than three points, and none of the differences is significant. We believe this is because the supervised stage already sets the format and the length of the answers, and the objective that follows has little room to change what the metrics count.
blocks.zh: 为了回答RQ III,我们按范式来划分方法. KnowRL, FactGPRO, and Faith 优化了GRPO, Dr. GRPO, and PPO的政策,而Flame和FactAlign则优化了DPO和KTO在优惠数据上的下线. 两个组都不与基于共同基准的基准模式相分离,TrealfulQA的两个大损失都来自于政策方法,其培训改变了产出格式. 为了将范式与从它开始的受监督的数据区分开来,表15单独列出每个受监督的阶段,表2列出其后的管道。 在短式基准上,校正步骤几乎没有增加任何内容,因为没有方法在精确度上移动超过.007,而且差异无一是显著的,尽管个别答案确实有变化,因为FactGRPO将38个TrealfulQA项目从不正确变为正确,42个则相反. 在长式基准上(对照表3的表16),对齐步骤移动精度和F1 @K\text{F1}@K相差小于三分,没有显著差异. 我们认为,这是因为受监督的阶段已经设定了答案的格式和长度,随后的目标几乎没有改变衡量尺度的空间。

blocks.en: 6 Reliability of Factuality Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6 事实评价的可靠性

blocks.en: To answer RQ IV , we examine short- and long-form evaluation pipelines whose components are stochastic, lack ground truth, or depend on the model pool. We thus treat RQ IV as a measurement question rather than a flaw of any single metric.
blocks.zh: 为了回答RQ IV,我们研究了短和长式评价管道,其组成部分有条理,缺乏地上真理,或者依赖于模型池. 因此,我们把RQ IV视为一个衡量问题,而不是任何单一衡量标准的一个缺陷。

blocks.en: VeriScore credits supported claims even when they are irrelevant or repeated (Appendix, Table 23 ). Relevance filtering lowers precision by 4–7 points on biographies and 11–15 on Alpaca-Fact for methods producing long responses (Table 3 ). Filler claims occur in 178–223 of 490 biography responses per method, but only once for Faith (Appendix Figures 4 and 5 ). The FactGRPO reward also credits these claims, enabling the reward hacking discussed under RQ II (Figure 3 ).

blocks.en: A true claim without retrieved support receives the same label as a false one. Re-verifying biography claims against the subject’s Wikipedia article lowers precision by about twenty points for methods producing long responses and changes their ranking (Appendix C.4 ). The article passages support only two fifths of the claims supported by web search. Changing the evidence source thus affects scores more than changing the method.

blocks.en: The short-form judge decides the absolute numbers, since regrading with gpt-oss-120b changes up to a third of the TruthfulQA labels (Table 20 ), although the large drops of FactGRPO and Faith persist.

blocks.en:
Two of the authors labeled the same 300 claims independently, 50 per variant and balanced over the automatic labels, without seeing those labels (Appendix C.5 ), and both judged 24 of them not to be claims at all. VeriScore agrees with their consensus on 84% of the claims (Cohen’s κ = 0.65 \kappa=0.65 ), counting claims that the evidence does not settle as unsupported, while the annotators agree with each other on 78% ( κ = 0.50 \kappa=0.50 ).
Where both annotators agree, VeriScore is right for 97% of the claims it accepts but only 65% of those it rejects, so its precision is, if anything, an underestimate.
The relevance labels agree with the consensus on 86% ( κ = 0.62 \kappa=0.62 ), and the LLM is right for 99% of the claims it keeps but only 55% of those it removes, so the drops under the relevance filter are an upper bound.

如果两个注释者都同意,VeriScore对97%的它所接受的主张是正确的,但只有65%的它所拒绝的主张是正确的,因此它的精确性,如果说有什么的话,是低估的。
关联标签同意86%(ob = 0.62\kappa= 0.62)的共识,LLM对它所保存的99%的主张是正确的,但只删除了55%的主张,因此在关联过滤器下放入的放出是上限.

blocks.en: The limitations discussed above underscore that both long-form and short-form scores serve as mere proxies for factuality rather than direct measures. Long-form evaluation assesses the consistency of extracted claims with retrieved evidence, whereas short-form evaluation relies on a judge’s assessment of agreement with a reference answer. Consequently, the lack of improvements on these metrics does not rule out gains in factuality in other ways. Future comparisons should use a common evaluation, report relevance-aware scores with claim counts and abstention rates, and release implementations matching the paper.
blocks.zh: 上文讨论的局限性强调,长式和短式的分数都只是事实的代名词,而不是直接衡量。 长式评价评估了所提取的索赔与所取取证据的一致性,而短式评价则取决于法官对协议的评估以及参考答复。 因此,这些衡量标准缺乏改进并不排除以其他方式取得实际收益。 今后的比较应采用共同评价,报告与索赔计数和弃权率相关联的分数,并公布与论文相匹配的执行情况。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we examined the reproducibility and comparability of five factuality alignment methods, evaluating each under its original experimental setup and under a shared setup with a common base model, judge, and verifier.
None fully reproduced its published results. Under the shared setup, no method significantly outperformed the untrained base model, except for an artifact associated with one-word answers and a small gain after relevance filtering. Our analysis further suggests that the rewards favor length, format, or brevity rather than the factuality measured by the benchmarks, and that on-policy and offline training perform alike.
We also found that evaluation choices, including relevance filtering, evidence sources, recall normalization, and the judge, affected scores more than the methods themselves.
These findings highlight the need for shared evaluation settings, relevance-aware metrics accompanied by claim counts and abstention rates, and released implementations consistent with the reported experiments.
Future work could consider additional methods and larger models, expand the human evaluation to more annotators and claims, and investigate rewards that credit only relevant, supported claims.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们审查了五种实际质量校正方法的可复制性和可比性,在最初的实验设置和共同设置下对每种方法进行评估,并采用共同的基础模型、判断和验证方法。
没有一份完全照搬其公布的结果。 在共享设置下,除了一个与一字答案相联的工艺品,以及关联过滤后的小收益外,没有方法显著地超过未受训练的基础模型. 我们的分析进一步表明,优待的长度、格式或简洁性,而不是根据基准衡量的事实质量,而且在线和在线培训同样发挥作用。
我们还发现,评价选择,包括相关性过滤、证据来源、召回正常化,以及法官的影响比方法本身要大。
这些调查结果突出表明,需要共享评价环境、具有相关性的衡量标准以及索赔清点和弃权率,并公布与所报告试验相一致的执行情况。
今后的工作可以考虑其他方法和更大的模式,将人的评价扩大到更多的注释者和索赔,并调查那些只涉及支持索赔的奖励。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our common evaluation uses Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with LoRA adapters, four English datasets, and smaller training budgets than the original papers. Results may differ with larger models, longer training, or full fine-tuning. Each method was trained once, leaving variance across seeds unmeasured.
blocks.zh: 我们的共同评价使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct与LORA适配器,4个英语数据集,培训预算比原始论文还小. 结果可能与更大的模型、更长的培训或全面微调不同。 每种方法都经过了一次培训,使不同种子的差异得不到衡量。

blocks.en: We document substitutions for unavailable artifacts, but cannot fully separate their effects from those of the methods. We also cannot inspect the training conditions of released checkpoints. Only one of the five author groups contacted had replied at the time of writing, leaving some discrepancies unresolved.
blocks.zh: 我们记录了现有文物的替代物,但不能将其效果与方法的效果完全分开。 我们还不能检查已释放检查站的训练条件。 在编写本报告时,联系到的五个提交人团体中只有一个作出答复,留下了一些不一致之处。

blocks.en: All scores rely on automatic claim extraction, web-based verification, commercial judges whose snapshots may change, and relevance labels from one LLM. Our human audit covers 300 claims checked by two annotators. Reference verification covers biographies only, as other datasets lack reference text. The fixed recall normalizer is one of several reasonable choices.
blocks.zh: 所有评分都依赖于自动索赔提取、网上核查、其快照可能改变的商业评委以及一个LLM的相关标签。 我们的人力审计覆盖了300项 由两个注释员检查的索赔。 由于其他数据集缺乏参考文本,参考文献的校验仅涵盖活页图. 固定召回正常化者是若干合理选择之一。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: All data come from public benchmarks. The released biography generations contain false claims about real people and are intended for factuality research, not as sources of biographical information.
blocks.zh: 所有数据都来自公共基准。 所出传记的几代人对真人有虚假的说法,意在进行事实研究,而不是作为传记资料的来源.

blocks.en: We follow the models’ licenses and release code, configurations, and adapters rather than full weights. The appendix reports GPU usage and the code repository estimated API costs; billed amounts were not recorded. The human audit was carried out by two of the authors.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循模型的许可和释放代码、配置和适配器,而不是全部重量。 附录报告了GPU的使用和代码存储库估计的API成本;账单金额没有记录. 人审计由两位作者进行.

blocks.en: Our reward-hacking results show that higher automatic scores need not imply more truthful answers. These scores alone should not certify a system’s factual reliability.
blocks.zh: 我们的奖励打击结果表明,自动得分较高并不一定意味着更真实的答案。 单靠这些分数不应证明系统的事实可靠性。

blocks.en: Use of AI Assistants
blocks.zh: 使用人工智能助理

We also used Opus 5.5 to rephrase parts of the paper to improve readability in addition to fixing typos and grammatical issues. All AI-assisted work was carried out under the authors’ supervision. The authors take full responsibility for the resulting code, experimental procedures, analyses, and claims made in the paper, including any errors that remain.

blocks.en: A.1 Flame

blocks.en: The paper fine-tunes Llama-2 70B in four variants, SFT and SFT followed by DPO as the standard pipeline, and their factuality-aware counterparts Sft f {}^{\text{f}} and Flame , which is Sft f {}^{\text{f}} followed by DPO f {}^{\text{f}} . We retrain all four with data rebuilt from the published sources, 3,200 Open Assistant pairs for instruction following and 1,630 judge examples for evaluation fine-tuning, 20K self-generated instructions, and preference data ranked by an instruction-following and a factuality reward model. Full fine-tuning of the 70B model runs with DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 and optimizer offload on two H200 GPUs, at about 260 seconds per SFT step and 500 per DPO step. The paper mixes its instruction and evaluation fine-tuning data in the SFT stage, whereas our Sft f {}^{\text{f}} set is built from the 3,200 instruction-following prompts alone, with the fact-seeking ones answered by Llama-2-70B samples. Three components are substituted. The paper’s reward models are not released, so the instruction-following reward is the 70B SFT model judging itself and the factuality reward is the recovered Inst-LLaMA checker. The factuality of open-ended instructions is scored with the same pipeline over an open retriever rather than with article-based FActScore. The AlpacaEval judge is gpt-4-turbo , since the paper’s gpt-4-1106-preview is retired.

blocks.en: A.3 KnowRL

blocks.en: The paper applies cold-start SFT followed by GRPO. Its reward combines format ( ± 1 \pm 1 ), correctness ( + 2 +2 correct, − 1 -1 incorrect, + 1 +1 refusal), and FActScore over reasoning for incorrect, non-refused answers. The repository provides cold-start data and refers to LLaMA-Factory, but leaves the RL model path unspecified. Its learning rate and adapter rank are 10 − 4 10^{-4} and 128, against 10 − 5 10^{-5} and 256 in the paper.
blocks.zh: 本文采用冷起动SFT,后为GRPO. 它的奖励结合了格式(±1\pm 1),正确性(+2+2正确,−1-1不正确,+1+1拒绝),FActScore比推理错误的,没有重复的答案. 该寄存器提供冷起数据并参考了LLaMA-Factory,但未指定RL模型路径. 它的学习率和适配器等级为10−4 10−4}和128,相较于论文中的10−5 10−5}和256.

blocks.en: Our first four runs reach 97%–100% refusals in the final fifth of training, with completion length falling from 344 to 89 tokens (Table 7 ). Two use released hyperparameters, with and without cold start; two use the paper’s hyperparameters without cold start. Cold-start SFT followed by 150 GRPO steps at 10 − 5 10^{-5} and rank 256 instead keeps refusals near 0.2% and reward near − 0.64 -0.64 . Cold start alone does not prevent collapse at the released learning rate.
blocks.zh: 我们的前四轮训练在最后的第五轮训练中达到97-100%的拒绝率,完成时间从344个到89个标志(表7)。 两种方法释放出超参数,有的没有冷启动;两种方法使用纸张的超参数,没有冷启动。 冷启动SFT之后的150个GRPO步骤在10 - 5 10 - 5} 排名为256, 拒绝率接近0.2%,奖励率接近 - 0.64-0.64。 单靠冷起步并不能防止在所释放的学习速率下崩溃.

blocks.en: The correctness term gives an attempt expected reward 3 ​ p − 1 3p-1 , against + 1 +1 for refusal, favoring refusal when p < 2 / 3 p<2/3 . A separate formatting error omits the opening reasoning tag from the factuality reward’s input, reducing extracted facts from 11.8 to 5.3 per response and leaving two fifths without facts. Repairing the tag restores the signal but does not prevent collapse. Our first cold-start model reduces refusals from 22.7% to 3.7% on 300 questions.
blocks.zh: " 正确性 " 一词使3 p - 1 3p-1对+1+1的拒绝给予预期的奖励,在p < 2 / 3 p < 2/3 时倾向于拒绝。 单独的格式化错误省略了真相奖励输入的开篇推理标记,将提取的事实从每回11.8个减少到了5.3个,留下了五分之二没有事实. 修复标记可以恢复信号,但不能防止崩溃. 我们的第一个冷启动模式 将拒绝率从22.7%降至3.7%。

blocks.en: The checkpoint’s SimpleQA gain reproduces: 1.92 to 4.56 in the paper, and 2.00 to 5.71 on our 500 items (Table 8 ). However, accuracy excludes refusals. Rejection rises from 10.2% to 93.0%, and correct answers fall from nine to two. The higher score therefore concerns a much smaller set of attempted questions.
blocks.zh: 检查站的SimpleQA增益转载了:报纸上有1.92至4.56,我们500个项目上有2.00至5.71(表8)。 但是,准确性不包括拒绝。 拒绝率从10.2%上升到93.0%,正确的答案从9%下降到了2%。 因此,较高的分数涉及一系列小得多的问题。

blocks.en: Mean rewards across 80-step blocks are 0.704, 0.704, 0.686, 0.741, and 0.718: a net rise of 0.014 against batch fluctuations up to 0.9. No malformed response occurs in 400 steps. Before evaluation, we predicted a gain far below the published result. Precision rises by 1.1 points on biographies and 2.8 on Alpaca-Fact, roughly a tenth of the published gains, while detail level falls (Table 11 ).

blocks.en: Although S / ( 1 + T ) S/(1+T) rewards more claims at fixed positive precision, our reduced-budget run does not recover the reported joint improvement. The required format appears in 83% of biography and 60% of Alpaca-Fact responses, but only 6% of SimpleQA and under 1% of TruthfulQA responses. SimpleQA answers are almost five times the base model’s length. Most short-form outputs would therefore incur the model’s own format penalty.
blocks.zh: 虽然S / ( 1 + T ) S / (1 + T ) S / (1 + T ) 以固定正精度奖励更多的索赔,但我们削减的预算运行并不能恢复所报告的联合改进。 所要求的格式出现在83%的传记和60%的阿尔帕卡事实回复中,但只有6%的SimpleQA和不到1%的TrealfulQA回复中. 简单 QA答案几乎是基准模型长度的5倍. 因此,大多数短式产出将受到该模型本身格式的惩罚。

blocks.en: The first run omitted the relevance term. We repeated training with the full reward and unchanged data, budget, and adapter; all common benchmark tables use this rerun. The runs receive identical grades on 80% of TruthfulQA and 81% of SimpleQA items, with no significant difference under McNemar’s exact test (Tables 9 and 12 ). Long-form scores differ by less than two points. The judge prefers the rerun’s responses to the base model’s in about one third of cases, contributing .03 to a mean reward near .3. We find no measurable benefit from this term under our budget.

blocks.en: A.5 Faith
blocks.zh: A.5 信仰

blocks.en: Faith trains a knowledge-state estimator, SFT model, reward model, and state-conditioned PPO policy, followed by a retrieval-based rectifier. The artifact includes four datasets, a trainer, and stage-specific configurations.
blocks.zh: Faith训练一个知识状态估计器,SFT模型,奖励模型,以及有状态条件的PPO政策,然后是一个基于检索的校正器. 文物包括4个数据集,1个教练器,以及舞台特有配置.

blocks.en: We train the first four stages on Meta-Llama-3-8B : 3 epochs each for the estimator and SFT, 2 for the reward model, and 2 PPO epochs over 10,000 of 93,904 prompts, about 310 steps or one fifth of a full-data pass. We follow the paper’s epoch counts rather than the released settings of 1 for the reward model and 0.45 for PPO.
blocks.zh: 我们在Meta-Llama-3-8B上训练前四个阶段:估计器和SFT各有3个时段,奖励模式有2个时段,以及2个PPO时段超过10 000个93 904个时段,大约310个时段或1/5的完整数据通过. 我们遵循论文的时代,

blocks.en: We omit the rectifier because its data and Llama-3 configuration were unavailable during our runs. The authors later supplied the data and confirmed that the configuration was lost. We therefore compare against the no-rectifier ablation. Our estimator replaces the authors’ stored evaluation states; using those states changes accuracy by at most 0.7 points, with 87.5% state agreement (Table 13 ).
blocks.zh: 我们省略了校正符,因为它的数据和Llama-3配置在我们运行期间是没有的。 提交人后来提供了数据并证实配置丢失了。 因此,我们比较了无校正器的减值。 我们的估算器取代了作者存储的评价状态;使用这些状态的精确度变化最多为0.7分,达到87.5%的州协议(表13 ).

blocks.en: PPO adds 0.33 points in mean precision over questions classified as known, against 1.20 for the published ablation and about ten for the full system (Table 14 ). Our SFT scores match the reported levels on TriviaQA and NQ-Open but fall short on SciQ and WebQuestions. Reward changes little, from − 0.37 -0.37 at step 9 to − 0.34 -0.34 at step 309.
blocks.zh: PPO比被归类为已知的问题增加了0.33个平均精度点,而公布的通缩为1.20个,整个系统约为10个(表14. 我们的SFT分数与TriviaQA和NQ-Open上报告的分数相匹配,但在SciQ和WebQuestion上却不足. 报酬变化不大,从第9步的0.37-0.37到第309步的0.34-0.34。

blocks.en: Questions classified as known are answered correctly more than twice as often as unknown questions on every dataset. Yet refusal rates are 0.000 on three datasets and 0.0003 on the fourth, despite 17%–56% of questions being classified as unknown. Truthfulness, which credits correct refusals, is therefore effectively accuracy.
blocks.zh: 被归类为已知的问题得到正确答案的频率是每个数据集未知问题的两倍多. 尽管有17. 56%的问题被归类为未知,但三个数据集的拒绝率为0.000,第四个数据集为0.0003。 因此,真实性是有效的准确性,这是纠正拒绝。

blocks.en: The reward model’s containment label accepts a prediction contained in the gold answer, or vice versa. This can credit incomplete answers, but does not by itself establish a preference for brevity. The short-answer SFT data offer a more direct explanation: mean biography length falls from 274 words in the base model to 3 after SFT and remains 3 after PPO. Adding the knowledge state does not restore long responses (Table 18 ). Since Faith is presented as general factuality alignment, this behavior matters beyond its short-answer training tasks.

blocks.en: C.5 Human Audit of Claim Labels

blocks.en:
The audit sample has 300 claims, 50 from each of the six variants of the common benchmark, with 200 from biography prompts and 100 from Alpaca-Fact prompts.
Within each variant and dataset, the claims are spread evenly over the four combinations of the VeriScore verdict and the relevance label, and at most one claim is drawn from a response.
Since the combinations are balanced, the agreement on the sample is not the agreement on all claims.
Two of the authors labeled the sample independently. For each claim, each annotator sees the prompt, the claim, the sentence it was extracted from with its neighbors, up to ten web search results, and, for biographies, up to ten passages from the subject’s Wikipedia article.
The automatic labels are not shown.
blocks.zh:
审计样本有300项索赔,共同基准的六个变体各有50项,其中200项来自传记提示,100项来自Alpaca-Fact提示。
在每一变式和数据集中,索赔均匀分布在VeriScore判决和关联性标签的四个组合上,最多一个索赔取自答复。
由于组合是平衡的,所以关于样本的协议并不是关于所有债权的协议.
两位作者将样本单独标出标签. 每个注释者都会看到它与其邻居一起提取的提示、声明和句子,
未显示自动标签 。

blocks.en:
Each annotator gives each claim up to three labels.
The first two judge whether the web evidence and the Wikipedia evidence support the claim, each with the labels Supported , Not supported , and Cannot tell from evidence .
A claim is supported when the evidence states or clearly implies every part of it, including names, dates, numbers, and places, and it is not supported when the evidence contradicts any part.
When the evidence neither supports nor contradicts the claim, for example because it is about something else, too vague, or cut off, the label is Cannot tell from evidence , and the same holds when only part of the claim is covered or when the evidence conflicts.
Annotators use only the evidence in the column being judged, not their own knowledge or a search, and treats evidence about a different entity with the same name as neither supporting nor contradicting the claim.
blocks.zh:
每个注释人最多给出了三个标签。
前两位判断网络证据和维基百科证据是否支持这一说法,
如果证据表明或明确暗示了索赔的每个部分,包括姓名、日期、数字和地点,则索赔得到支持;如果证据与任何部分相矛盾,则索赔得不到支持。
当证据既不支持也不与索赔相矛盾时,例如,因为涉及的是别的东西、太模糊或断绝时,标签无法从证据中得知,当只涵盖索赔的一部分或当证据冲突时,同样的情况也是如此。
注释者只使用所判断一栏中的证据,而不是他们自己的知识或搜索,并将关于同名实体的证据视为既不支持也不反驳索赔。

blocks.en:
The third label judges whether the claim is Relevant or Irrelevant to the prompt, treating the claim as true.
A claim is relevant when it gives information that the prompt asks for about its subject, such as any fact about the life, family, education, career, work, or legacy of the person in a biography prompt.
It is irrelevant when it is mainly about something else, such as a related person, place, organization, or event, when it falls outside the scope of the prompt or adds detail that was not asked for, or when it is a statement about the answer, the task, or the model.
When unsure, annotators choose Irrelevant , and a free-text note flags claims that are garbled or are not claims at all.
After a check of the first annotator’s labels against these rules flagged blank labels and labels that contradict a rule, that annotator revised the labels they agreed with.
blocks.zh:

一项索赔在提供即时要求有关其对象的信息时是相关的,例如传记中任何关于个人生活、家庭、教育、职业、工作或遗产的事实。
